name: ai-attribution
description: Records how much of your code was typed and how much appeared, and reports the split to Hackatime.

aiAttribution.enabled.description: Send the typed/appeared line split to your Hackatime account. Off until you turn it on.

aiAttribution.apiKey.markdownDescription: Hackatime API key. Leave blank to use the one already in `~/.wakatime.cfg`.

aiAttribution.apiUrl.markdownDescription: Hackatime API base URL. Leave blank to use `~/.wakatime.cfg`, then the Hack Club default.

aiAttribution.debug.description: Log every classified change and every delivery to the AI Attribution output channel.
